description: Recipe for tools/import_real_track.py: Oulton Park (Little Budworth, Cheshire, UK), MSV. The International circuit with the Island and Fosters circuits sharing its base: all three current layouts (MSV's circuit-layouts page lists exactly these three; Wikipedia and racingcircuits.info give the same three, 2003 to date).
name: Oulton Park
trackDescription: Oulton Park, International (4.31 km), Island (3.62 km) and Fosters (2.66 km) circuits from OpenStreetMap, with heights, camber and terrain from the Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM (1 m). Cheshire parkland with mature woodland and Oulton Lake inside the circuit.

lakes.note: OSM natural=water: Oulton Park Lake (inside the circuit, beside Lakeside), Budworth Pool, Oulton Mill Pond and the small ponds; levels from the LIDAR water surface.

layoutSource: MSV official map 'Oulton Park International Circuit' (oultonpark.co.uk/about/circuit-layouts, 'OP Map_International Circuit.pdf'): Old Hall Corner - The Avenue - Dentons - Cascades - Lakeside - Island Bend - Shell Oils Corner - Brittens - Hilltop - Hislops - Knickerbrook - Clay Hill - Druids Corner - Warwick Bridge - Lodge Corner - Deer Leap; 2.69 mi / 4.30 km (MSV; Wikipedia 4.307 km; racingcircuits.info 4.333 km).
directionSource: MSV official International map: the arrow beside the chequered flag on the pit straight points down towards Old Hall Corner (clockwise); coachdaveacademy.com and driver61.com track guides: Old Hall is turn 1 and Deer Leap the final kink onto the start/finish straight.

startFinish.note: OSM node raceway=start-finish where Deer Leap meets the pit straight.

startFinishSource: MSV official International, Island and Fosters maps: the chequered flag on the pit straight just after Deer Leap, beside race control and the pit garages; OSM node 235311718 (raceway=start-finish) at the end of Deer Leap; coachdaveacademy.com: Deer Leap is 'the final left kink onto the start/finish straight'.

altLayouts.name: Island
altLayouts.layoutSource: MSV official map 'Oulton Park Island Circuit' ('OP Map_Island Circuit.pdf'): the International with the Island Hairpin (OSM ways 27299255, 820427876) from the end of Lakeside straight onto Hilltop, missing Island Bend, Shell Oils Corner and Brittens; 2.26 mi / 3.616 km (MSV, Wikipedia; racingcircuits.info 3.637 km).
altLayouts.directionSource: MSV official Island map: the same arrow by the flag towards Old Hall Corner (clockwise).
altLayouts.startFinishSource: MSV official Island map: the chequered flag at the same place on the pit straight as on the International map, so the Island shares its line and grid.

altLayouts.name: Fosters
altLayouts.layoutSource: MSV official map 'Oulton Park Fosters Circuit' ('OP Map_Fosters Circuit.pdf'): the International to Cascades, then Fosters (OSM way 29187915 "Foster's") across to Knickerbrook; 1.66 mi / 2.656 km (MSV, Wikipedia; racingcircuits.info 2.662 km). Built through Hislop's chicane (Wikipedia: 'half of Cascades followed by the Hislop's chicane'); MSV's current map instead draws the Fosters link joining the old straight to Knickerbrook (OSM 27299256), Hislop's in grey, and that lap measures 2,649 m on OSM (MSV 2,656 m, through Hislop's 2,670 m). It crosses the International's line at the chicane entry, a flat crossing the importer and geometry don't support for imported tracks yet (tried 2026-10-24: crossing-needs-annotation), so it stays open.
altLayouts.directionSource: MSV official Fosters map: the same arrow by the flag towards Old Hall Corner (clockwise); racingcircuits.info: Fosters diverts 'off after Cascades to a tight right-hander leading to Knickerbrook'.
altLayouts.startFinishSource: MSV official Fosters map: the chequered flag at the same place on the pit straight as on the International map, so the Fosters shares its line and grid.

sharpWaysNote: Brittens (OSM 820427208) and Hislop's (820427209) are tight bus-stop chicanes on the Hill straight (MSV's maps draw both as sharp jinks); the importer's 5 m smoothing made them 30 m radius S-bends taken flat out (Chris, 2026-10-23: a 'bus stop' chicane on the big straight 'that we don't have'), so their corners are kept sharp (tools/import_real_track.py, sharpWays).
widthsNote: Measured tarmac widths (tools/real_tracks/widths/oultonpark.json, tools/real_tracks_data/measure_width.py) from the open LIDAR point cloud; widthM is only the nominal width the registration and the fallback use; the spec's options.widthM becomes the measured median.
widthNote: Not published; about 9-11 m on imagery. One value for the whole lap.
expectedCornerOrderNote: Clockwise International lap as on the MSV map and in the coachdaveacademy.com / driver61.com guides (Water Tower, the kink between Clay Hill and Druids, is named in OSM, not on the MSV map). The Island Hairpin and Fosters links aren't on the International lap, so they aren't labelled.

kerbs.source: coachdaveacademy.com Oulton guide: inside front wheel onto the kerb; 'use all of the exit kerb available' (strict track limits)

coachdaveacademy.com: the inside kerb is usable with the inside wheels
coachdaveacademy.com: touch the entry kerb early on turn-in (a hairpin)
coachdaveacademy.com: kerbs and matting through Britten's chicane; driver61.com: a 'huge first kerb'
coachdaveacademy.com: the flat part of the first red and white kerb, the inside kerb at the second apex; driver61.com: a 'large first kerb'
coachdaveacademy.com: front right over the apex kerb; the exit kerb is usable but bites back
coachdaveacademy.com: late apex around the middle of the inside kerb

coachdaveacademy.com: front right onto the inside kerb; the exit kerb is usable, the matting beyond it is track limits

kerbsNote: OSM has no kerb or run-off features at Oulton Park (Overpass 2026-10-20: no barrier=kerb, kerb=* or area:highway), and the 1 m DTM can't resolve kerbs, so these overrides come from track guides; other corners (Dentons, Hilltop, Water Tower, Warwick Bridge, Deer Leap, the Island Hairpin and Fosters) get the geometric placement.
runoffNote: Run-off surfaces, barriers (type, offset, debris fences) and trees measured from open LIDAR and OSM plus published sources: tools/real_tracks/runoff|vegetation/<slug>.json (tools/real_tracks_data/measure_runoff.py, runoff_evidence.json); docs/real-tracks.md, Run-off and foliage.
